# encrypt and decrypt with mixed native recipients (x25519 + hybrid), threshold 2
exec age-plugin-sss --generate-recipient policy.yaml
cmp stdout policy.pub
! stderr .

exec age-plugin-sss --generate-identity identity.yaml
cmp stdout identity.txt
! stderr .

exec age -R policy.pub -o test.age input
! stderr .

# decrypt with both identities combined (threshold=2)
exec age -d -i identity.txt test.age
cmp stdout input
! stderr .

# individual identities should fail (insufficient shares)
! exec age -d -i identity-x25519-only.txt test.age
stderr 'no identity matched any of the recipients'

! exec age -d -i identity-hybrid-only.txt test.age  
stderr 'no identity matched any of the recipients'

-- input --
it works with mixed native recipients

  - recipient:
